name: @adrata/bounce-mcp

tools.name: connect_workspace
tools.description: Connect your Adrata workspace via OAuth 2.0. Opens a browser window for authorization. By default the connection is READ-ONLY (least privilege): search/read companies, people, opportunities, pipeline, buyer groups, signals and analytics, plus the governed AI dispatcher for reads. Pass writeAccess:true to additionally request the CRM write scopes (companies, people, buyer groups, opportunities, actions, tasks) so create/update/delete work from this client; you will see them on the consent screen and can decline. Workspace administration and enrichment spend are never requested and always require a signed-in human session. The capability summary returned is derived from the scope the server actually granted, not from what was requested.

writeAccess.description: Request CRM write scopes in addition to read. Defaults to false (read-only).

tools.name: disconnect_workspace
tools.description: Disconnect your Adrata workspace. Revokes OAuth tokens and clears local credentials. Enterprise tools will no longer be available after disconnecting.

tools.name: workspace_status
tools.description: Check which credential this MCP server is actually running on, what tier it grants, which workspace it is acting in, and whether that credential still works. Run this first when a tool returns 401 or 403 — it names the credential in play and what to do about it.

tools.name: list_workspaces
tools.description: List the workspaces the authenticated user is actually a member of, with their role in each. Use before switch_workspace when a user belongs to more than one workspace.

tools.name: switch_workspace
tools.description: Switch the active workspace for the authenticated user. Subsequent tool calls read and write in the new workspace. Use list_workspaces first to get valid IDs.

tools.name: search_capabilities
tools.description: Search the authorized capability registry without loading schemas into context. A branded server fixes the namespace to its product. Search is discovery only: describe one exact result before run_capability, and never execute a fuzzy result.

query.description: Plain-language intent. Empty lists a bounded sample.

namespace.description: Optional only on the unprofiled server; a product profile cannot search another product.

tools.name: describe_capability
tools.description: Resolve one exact, versioned capability reference and return its input schema, risk, and execution metadata. This never executes the capability.

ref.description: Exact /product/domain/action reference; never a fuzzy search phrase.

tools.name: run_capability
tools.description: Run one exact capability through the governed dispatcher. Defaults to dry-run. Live writes remain subject to server-bound approval, reason, spend, policy, and idempotency controls. Product profiles refuse references outside their namespace.

dryRun.description: Defaults true. Set false only after reviewing the exact schema and preview.

confirmationToken.description: Single-use server-bound token when the capability requires one.

idempotencyKey.description: Required by governed live writes/spend. Reuse the same key on retry.

tools.name: create_action
tools.description: Log an action (outreach, call, meeting, note) against a person or company. Metadata is JSONB for type-specific data.

type.description: email, call, meeting, note, linkedin_connection_request, linkedin_message, task

tools.name: list_actions
tools.description: List actions with filters. Use to answer "what did X do this week?" Use viewMode:"leader" to see the whole team's activity rather than only your own.

viewMode.description: seller = your own actions (default). leader = the whole team's actions; requires workspace admin.

tools.name: get_action
tools.description: Get full action details including metadata.

tools.name: update_action
tools.description: Update an action. Metadata is JSONB-merged.

tools.name: complete_action
tools.description: Mark action as completed with optional outcome.

tools.name: delete_action
tools.description: Soft-delete an action.

tools.name: list_overdue_actions
tools.description: List actions past their due date.

tools.name: list_today_actions
tools.description: List actions scheduled for today.

tools.name: list_agent_tasks
tools.description: List long-running agent/background tasks with status and progress.

tools.name: create_agent_task
tools.description: Create a long-running agent/background task for research, enrichment, auditing, or custom workflow automation.

type.description: Task type such as account_research, lead_enrichment, sequence_optimization, pipeline_review, or custom

tools.name: get_agent_task
tools.description: Get detail, progress, and result for a long-running agent/background task.

tools.name: cancel_agent_task
tools.description: Cancel a queued or running agent/background task.

tools.name: list_webhook_events
tools.description: List supported outbound webhook event types, payload schemas, and examples.

tools.name: list_webhooks
tools.description: List outbound webhook subscriptions for the workspace.

tools.name: create_webhook
tools.description: Create an outbound webhook subscription. Returns the signing secret once; store it securely.

tools.name: update_webhook
tools.description: Update an outbound webhook subscription URL, events, active flag, description, or filter expression.

tools.name: delete_webhook
tools.description: Delete an outbound webhook subscription.

tools.name: test_webhook
tools.description: Queue a signed webhook.test delivery to validate a subscription endpoint.

tools.name: list_webhook_deliveries
tools.description: List recent delivery attempts for a webhook subscription.

tools.name: get_webhook_delivery
tools.description: Get status, response body, and retry metadata for a webhook delivery attempt.

tools.name: replay_webhook_delivery
tools.description: Replay a failed or previous webhook delivery.

tools.name: search_emails
tools.description: Search emails by subject, sender, recipient, or folder.

tools.name: get_email
tools.description: Get full email content by ID.

tools.name: count_emails
tools.description: Count emails by folder or status.

tools.name: list_meetings
tools.description: List your meetings (calendar events) with optional filters.

tools.name: get_meeting
tools.description: Get meeting (calendar event) details, including the attendee roster.

tools.name: get_meeting_summary
tools.description: Get AI summary of a meeting.

tools.name: get_meeting_action_items
tools.description: Get action items from a meeting.

tools.name: get_activity_summary
tools.description: Aggregated activity metrics (calls, emails, meetings) over time.

tools.name: list_campaigns
tools.description: List campaigns with optional status filter.

tools.name: get_campaign
tools.description: Get campaign details and performance metrics.

tools.name: list_sequences
tools.description: List email sequences.

tools.name: get_sequence
tools.description: Get sequence details including steps.

tools.name: get_current_user
tools.description: Get the currently authenticated user.

tools.name: log_interaction
tools.description: Log a sales interaction — finds the person (or creates them), creates an action with metadata, and optionally updates the person's customFields. This is the primary tool for recording outreach activity. One call does everything.

personEmail.description: Email of the person (used to find/create)

type.description: Interaction type: linkedin_connection_request, linkedin_message, email, call, meeting, note

title.description: What happened, e.g. "Sent LinkedIn connection request"

outcome.description: Result: accepted, pending, replied, no_response, meeting_booked

message.description: The message sent (stored in action metadata)

customFields.description: Additional fields to set on the person record

tools.name: who_am_i
tools.description: Get your user profile with usage statistics — tier, top tools used, recent activity, saved memories count, and industries researched. Useful for understanding your Adrata context.

tools.name: upgrade_account
tools.description: Open the Adrata Edition signup page in your browser to upgrade your account. Free users get a 14-day Pro trial (no credit card required). Pro users can manage their subscription. Enterprise users are directed to schedule a demo.

plan.description: Target plan: "pro" for self-serve upgrade, "enterprise" for sales contact. Defaults to "pro".

tools.name: check_subscription
tools.description: Check your current Adrata subscription plan, usage limits, trial status, and billing details. Works at all tiers: free users see upgrade options, pro users see usage and trial countdown, enterprise users see full workspace subscription details.

tools.name: get_workspace_settings
tools.description: View your workspace configuration, enabled modules, rate limits, user count, and subscription details. Use this to understand what features are available. Enterprise only.

tools.name: search_domains
tools.description: Search for available domains to purchase for email sending. Returns matching domains with pricing and availability. Enterprise only.

tools.name: purchase_domain
tools.description: Purchase a domain for email sending through Adrata. The domain will be added to your workspace and ready for DNS setup. Enterprise only.

autoSetup.description: Automatically configure DNS records after purchase (default: true)

tools.name: setup_domain
tools.description: Configure DNS records (SPF, DKIM, DMARC) for an email sending domain. Required before sending emails from the domain. Enterprise only.

tools.name: verify_domain
tools.description: Check DNS propagation status for an email domain. Returns verification status for SPF, DKIM, and DMARC records. Enterprise only.

tools.name: list_domains
tools.description: List all email sending domains in your workspace with health status. Shows verification state, deliverability scores, and active mailbox counts. Enterprise only.

status.description: Filter by status: verified, pending, failed

tools.name: create_email_account
tools.description: Provision a new email mailbox on an owned domain. Creates the account and optionally starts warmup. Enterprise only.

domain.description: Domain to create the account on (must be a verified domain in your workspace)

username.description: Username/local part of the email (e.g. "sarah" for sarah@domain.com)

displayName.description: Display name for the sender (e.g. "Sarah Johnson")

autoWarmup.description: Start warmup immediately after creation (default: false)

tools.name: list_email_accounts
tools.description: List email mailboxes in your workspace. Optionally filter by domain. Shows warmup status and health scores. Enterprise only.

status.description: Filter by status: active, warming, paused, disabled

tools.name: warmup_email
tools.description: Start or stop gradual sending warmup for an email account. Warmup builds sender reputation by slowly increasing send volume. Enterprise only.

action.description: Start or stop the warmup process

tools.name: get_email_health
tools.description: Get the deliverability health score for an email account. Returns sender reputation, bounce rate, spam complaints, and warmup progress. Enterprise only.

tools.name: create_sequence
tools.description: Create a new multi-step email sequence. Define the name and optionally include initial steps. Steps specify delay, subject, and body template. Enterprise only.

steps.description: Initial sequence steps. Can also add steps later with add_sequence_step.

delayDays.description: Days to wait before sending this step (0 for first step = send immediately)

type.description: Step type: email (default), linkedin_view, linkedin_connect, call, manual

mailboxId.description: Default mailbox ID to send from

tools.name: list_sequences_full
tools.description: List email sequences with full details including status, step count, and enrollment metrics. Enterprise only.

status.description: Filter by status: draft, active, paused, completed

tools.name: add_sequence_step
tools.description: Add a step to an existing sequence. Steps are executed in order with configurable delays between them. Enterprise only.

sequenceId.description: Sequence ID to add the step to

order.description: Step order (1-based). Inserts at this position.

delayDays.description: Days to wait before sending this step (relative to previous step)

type.description: Step type: email (default), linkedin_view, linkedin_connect, call, manual

tools.name: activate_sequence
tools.description: Activate a sequence to start sending emails to enrolled contacts. The sequence must have at least one step and enrolled contacts. Enterprise only.

tools.name: pause_sequence
tools.description: Pause a running sequence. Enrolled contacts will stop receiving emails until the sequence is reactivated. Enterprise only.

tools.name: get_sequence_analytics
tools.description: Get performance analytics for a sequence. Returns open rates, reply rates, bounce rates, unsubscribe rates, and per-step metrics. Enterprise only.

sequenceId.description: Sequence ID to get analytics for

tools.name: enroll_contacts
tools.description: Enroll contacts into a sequence. Contacts will begin receiving sequence emails according to the step schedule. Enterprise only.

sequenceId.description: Sequence ID to enroll contacts into

contactIds.description: Array of person/contact IDs to enroll

mailboxId.description: Override mailbox ID for these enrollments

tools.name: schedule_demo
tools.description: Book a product demo with Adrata. Free tier — no account needed. Creates a calendar event via Cal.com. The attendee receives an email confirmation automatically.

tools.name: schedule_meeting
tools.description: Preview or create a meeting through Adrata chat’s governed calendar path. Live creation requires an audit reason and the server-issued confirmation token returned by the first approved request. Provider delivery remains pending until sync confirms it.

eventId.description: Existing Adrata event ID to update instead of creating a duplicate

dryRun.description: Defaults to true. Set false after explicit approval to request a confirmation token.

reason.description: Required audit reason when requesting a live-write confirmation token.

confirmationToken.description: Single-use server token from the approved first request.

tools.name: list_toolsets
tools.description: List available composite toolsets. Each toolset contains multiple high-level tools. Use enable_toolset to load one into your session. Only toolsets your tier can access are shown.

tools.name: enable_toolset
tools.description: Load a toolset into the current session. This registers all tools in the named toolset so you can call them. Use list_toolsets first to see what's available.

name.description: Toolset name: prospecting, intelligence, outreach, crm, communications, infrastructure, knowledge, matrix

tools.name: get_demo_availability
tools.description: Check available demo time slots from Cal.com. Returns the next 5 available slots for scheduling a product demo. Free tier — no account needed. Falls back to a booking link if Cal.com API is unavailable.

tools.name: check_inbox
tools.description: Check your inbox for new replies. Cross-references with CRM contacts and active sequences to classify reply types (positive, OOO, meeting request, not interested) and suggest Next Moves. The "Did anyone get back to me?" tool.

since.description: Check replies since date (ISO string, default: yesterday)
